WITH win AS (
                SELECT sequence, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sequence) AS rn
                FROM persistent_outbox_events
                WHERE sequence > $1
                  AND sequence <= $1 + $2
            )
            SELECT e.sequence AS "sequence!: i64", e.id AS "id!", e.payload,
                   e.tracing_context, e.provenance, e.recorded_at AS "recorded_at!", e.commit_xid
            FROM persistent_outbox_events e
            WHERE e.sequence > $1
              AND e.sequence <= $1 + $2
              AND e.sequence < (
                  SELECT COALESCE(MIN(sequence), $1 + $2 + 1)
                  FROM win
                  WHERE sequence <> $1 + rn
              )
            ORDER BY e.sequence ASC
